lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            have ⟨σ, t₁, eq⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
            exists t₁ ^ᵗᵗ t₂
            grind
        | inr red_r =>
            obtain ⟨t₂', _⟩ := red_r
            exists t₁.app t₂'
            grind
    | inr red_l =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red_l
        exists t₁'.app t₂
        grind
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>
    right
    specialize ih rfl der
    cases ih with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, t, _⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exists t ^ᵗᵞ σ'
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .tapp t' σ'
        grind
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl _ =>
        exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.let' t₂
        grind
  case inl der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inl t'
        grind
  case inr der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inr t'
        grind
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        have ⟨t₁, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
        cases lr <;> [exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁; exists t₃ ^ᵗᵗ t₁] <;> grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.case t₂ t₃
        grind
  case sub => grind
  case abs σ _ τ L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.abs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind only [→ wf]
  case tabs L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.tabs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind only [→ wf]

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            obtain ⟨δ, body, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
            exact Or.inr ⟨body ^ᵗᵗ t₂, Term.Red.abs (Typing.wf l).2.1 val_r⟩
        | inr red_r =>
            obtain ⟨t₂', step⟩ := red_r
            exact Or.inr ⟨Term.app t₁ t₂', Term.Red.appᵣ val_l step⟩
    | inr red_l =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', step⟩ := red_l
        exact Or.inr ⟨Term.app t₁' t₂, Term.Red.appₗ (Typing.wf r).2.1 step⟩
  case tapp σ' der sub ih =>
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨δ, body, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exact Or.inr ⟨body ^ᵗᵞ σ', Term.Red.tabs (Typing.wf der).2.1 (Sub.wf [] σ' _ sub).2.1⟩
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', step⟩ := red
        exact Or.inr ⟨Term.tapp t' σ', Term.Red.tapp (Sub.wf [] σ' _ sub).2.1 step⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L d body ih _ =>
    have hbody : t₂.body := (Term.body_let.mp (Typing.wf (Typing.let' L d body)).2.1).2
    cases ih rfl d with
    | inl val =>
        exact Or.inr ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, Term.Red.let_body val hbody⟩
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', step⟩ := red
        exact Or.inr ⟨Term.let' t₁' t₂, Term.Red.let_bind step hbody⟩
  case inl d _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl d with
    | inl val => exact Or.inl (Term.Value.inl val)
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', step⟩ := red
        exact Or.inr ⟨Term.inl t', Term.Red.inl step⟩
  case inr d _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl d with
    | inl val => exact Or.inl (Term.Value.inr val)
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', step⟩ := red
        exact Or.inr ⟨Term.inr t', Term.Red.inr step⟩
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ d h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    have ⟨b₂, b₃⟩ := (Term.body_case.mp (Typing.wf (Typing.case L d h₂ h₃)).2.1).2
    cases ih rfl d with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨u, h⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum val
        cases h with
        | inl e => subst t₁; exact Or.inr ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ u, Term.Red.case_inl e b₂ b₃⟩
        | inr e => subst t₁; exact Or.inr ⟨t₃ ^ᵗᵗ u, Term.Red.case_inr e b₂ b₃⟩
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', step⟩ := red
        exact Or.inr ⟨Term.case t₁' t₂ t₃, Term.Red.case step b₂ b₃⟩
  case sub => grind
  case abs σ _ τ L _ _ =>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.abs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind only [→ wf]
  case tabs L _ _ =>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.tabs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind only [→ wf]

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            obtain ⟨δ, body, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
            exact .inr ⟨body ^ᵗᵗ t₂, .abs (l.wf).2.1 val_r⟩
        | inr red =>
            rcases red with ⟨t₂', step⟩
            exact .inr ⟨t₁.app t₂', .appᵣ val_l step⟩
    | inr red =>
        rcases red with ⟨t₁', step⟩
        exact .inr ⟨t₁'.app t₂, .appₗ (r.wf).2.1 step⟩
  case tapp σ' der sub ih =>
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨δ, body, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exact .inr ⟨body ^ᵗᵞ σ', .tabs (der.wf).2.1 (Sub.wf [] σ' _ sub).2.1.lc⟩
    | inr red =>
        rcases red with ⟨t', step⟩
        exact .inr ⟨.tapp t' σ', .tapp (Sub.wf [] σ' _ sub).2.1.lc step⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L d body ih _ =>
    have hbody : t₂.body := (body_let.mp ((Typing.let' L d body).wf).2.1).2
    cases ih rfl d with
    | inl val =>
        exact .inr ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, .let_body val hbody⟩
    | inr red =>
        rcases red with ⟨t₁', step⟩
        exact .inr ⟨t₁'.let' t₂, .let_bind step hbody⟩
  case inl d _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl d <;> grind [cases Red, cases Value]
  case inr d _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl d <;> grind [cases Red, cases Value]
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ L d h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    have ⟨b₂, b₃⟩ := (body_case.mp ((Typing.case L d h₂ h₃).wf).2.1).2
    cases ih rfl d with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨u, h⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum val
        cases h with
        | inl e =>
            subst t₁
            cases val with
            | inl vu => exact .inr ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ u, .case_inl vu b₂ b₃⟩
        | inr e =>
            subst t₁
            cases val with
            | inr vu => exact .inr ⟨t₃ ^ᵗᵗ u, .case_inr vu b₂ b₃⟩
    | inr red =>
        rcases red with ⟨t₁', step⟩
        exact .inr ⟨t₁'.case t₂ t₃, .case step b₂ b₃⟩
  case sub => grind
  case abs σ _ τ L h ih => exact .inl (.abs (Typing.abs L h).wf.2.1)
  case tabs σ _ τ L h ih => exact .inl (.tabs (Typing.tabs L h).wf.2.1)
